verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a physical GPU accelerator with its ROCm software stack, not a hosted data service. Choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this kind of product, since data location is set by whoever deploys the hardware. The 'Instinct on Azure' getting-started doc describes a host platform, not a residency control the product itself ships.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
